title.zh: 查询可用性监控任务列表

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询当前账号的可用性监控任务列表。返回结果显示，当前账号存在一条可用性监控任务记录`ecs_instance`。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to query the list of availability monitoring tasks for the current account. The response shows that the current account has one availability monitoring task record `ecs_instance`.
